text:
Amanda H: Hey all — attaching the FY26 Q2 OKR draft for company-level alignment. Need agreement on launch criteria, scope tradeoffs, and which customer asks are GA blockers vs enterprise pilots. Please read and confirm by end of week. Link: https://redwood.internal/okrs/fy26-q2-draft :eyes:

Raj K: Looking now. Quick Q — what sequence length distribution are we assuming for the latency targets?

Amanda H: Good Q. Baseline is median 128 tokens, p95 at 512. I'll add that to the doc unless objections.

Miguel O: From infra perspective the Dedicated revenue ramp expects ~10% sustained utilization on reserved pools. We should be explicit about minimum commit size — if customers commit for <6 months, we can't guarantee SLA.

Priya S: Two gov-fin prospects insist on on-prem + HSM by GA. Sales wants an earlier slot. I'd like us to call those out as "customer-driven" asks and not block GA unless security/ops say so.

Elena V: Console UX note — VPC & on-prem setup needs a much simpler flow. Suggest a soft-launch: ship with docs + one UX tweak (no full redesign) to meet GA.

Sam T: Security: HSM/KMS integration will need architecture review and pen test. Realistic earliest GA is ~6 weeks after code merge. Also add audit-log requirements to acceptance criteria.

Amanda H: Action items summary:
- Raj: add seq-length assumptions to doc
- Miguel: add commit-utilization guardrail language
- Priya/Sales: mark HSM as enterprise-req and propose pilot options
- Elena: define "minimum viable flow" for Console
- Sam: add security checklist and pen-test milestone
I'll update the doc by EOD and re-post. :thumbsup:

Priya S: For those two prospects I'll offer a dedicated pilot vs GA timeline and keep leadership copied.

Raj K: Tech suggestion — Optimize OKR's quantization recommendation needs a small config flag to control allowed quality loss. Example:
```
{"loss_budget_pct": 1.5}
```
Otherwise we'll see ML teams over-optimize cost and drift quality.

Elena V: I can own the 2 copy + 1 modal change for the Console soft-flow.

Miguel O: Risk note — week 8 of Q2 the major cloud provider has a maintenance window. Recommend canary + gradual ramp to avoid incident.

Amanda H: Proposed sign-off process: technical owners confirm acceptance criteria by Thu COB, leadership provides final thumbs by Fri noon. If no objections by then, we consider it signed. Any objections?

Sam T: No objection, but security checklist must be completed before leadership thumbs-up.

Raj K: No objection. I'll deliver infra PRs for latency tracking by Wed.

Priya S: No objection from Sales; we'll coordinate customer comms for pilots.

Miguel O: No objections.

Elena V: :thumbsup: will update mocks.

Amanda H: Thanks — updating the draft now. ops-bot please create a board column "Q2 OKR signoff" and add owners.

ops-bot: Created board column "Q2 OKR signoff" and added cards: Latency targets (Raj K), Dedicated commit guardrails (Miguel O), HSM scoping (Priya S / Sam T), Console soft-flow (Elena V).

Amanda H: I'll ping when the doc is updated. Thanks everyone.
